notes: The cut iris heart in the gate's valve ring. Anchor = gem centre. A step-cut gem: bright upper-left edge, pale left facets, mid right facets and one dark lower-right facet. Only the table core and the bright edge are emissive. badly_cracked stutters and has lost its lower-right facet. shattered: the facets split off a blazing core (use it for the death burst). This is the Warden's light source: one point light.
